title: How to Build a Brand With Meta Ads
description: How to Build a Brand With Meta Ads
transcript: This is how you build a brand with meta ads. Most businesses use meta ads to generate leads and sales, and that makes sense, but if you do it smartly, you can also build a brand at the same time if you use a combination of founder LED ads and partnership ads where you partner with creators and influencers to promote your products and services on your behalf. If you partner with the right people and you get the tone right, the values that your target audience associate with those creators and influencers can translate to your brand over time.
